name: Eversource Energy
description: Eversource is a New England wires-and-pipes holding company: CL&P (about 1.32 million electric customers in Connecticut), NSTAR Electric (about 1.62 million in Massachusetts) and PSNH (New Hampshire) deliver but do not own generation; Yankee Gas, NSTAR Gas and EGMA distribute natural gas; and its water business, Aquarion, was sold on June 30, 2026 for about $2.4 billion. Its electric transmission segment earned the most in 2025 ($776.7M, 42% of regulated companies' earnings from 17% of segment revenue) because FERC formula rates pay a return on a very large transmission rate base. The 2026 first-half earnings drop reflects a $111.4M after-tax charge on the Aquarion sale.
